page.overview:
Who is Richie Gunzit?

Richie Gunzit is a character from Cars 3. He is a Next-gen racer that races for Gasprin. He replaced Floyd Mulvihill in the 2016 mid-season.

Richie enters the Piston Cup Racing Series during the mid-season as he joined the Gasprin team as a replacement for the previous racer, Floyd Mulvihill. He finished 4th in the race at the Rustbelt Raceway. In the Florida 500 race he started from 18th place. During the wreck caused by Cam Spinner, Richie can be seen dodging other cars to the point where he went on the outfield of the track. He can also been seen going into the pits to get repaired and finish the race.
